subject: MAP proposal: split release + procurement credit escrow request
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP proposal: split release + procurement credit escrow request

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Based on our internal dev cadence and your rollout constraints, we want to propose a slightly different MAP: split the acceptance into two incremental windows (core API + integration adapter), rather than a single go/no-go on the full bundle.

Why we think this helps:
- Gives Greenline an earlier, testable surface (API) for clinician workflows while we finalize the adapter.
- Reduces your risk on the critical path while keeping the overall timeline intact.

Request: because this split increases our delivery overhead and Greenline has a procurement holdback in place, we'd like to propose a small credit escrow to be released on completion of the second window. Target: $25k escrow, released on final acceptance. We can represent this in the SOW as a conditional invoice/credit line.

I've attached a redline SOW and a one-page MAP sketch (MAP_proposal_20260828.xlsx). Can you confirm whether procurement would accept an escrow approach and what evidence they'd require (e.g., SOC2 equivalency, audit log extracts)?

Proposed next steps:
1) Procurement acceptance of escrow approach (your team)
2) Redwood provides SOC2 equivalency notes + final redline SOW
3) Legal review and sign

If useful, Ben can join a short call with procurement next week.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Attachments: MAP_proposal_20260828.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_v1_redline.pdf (pdf)

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor_ops@greenlinehealth.com, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-29T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP proposal: split release + procurement credit escrow request

Naomi —

Appreciate the clear proposal. Procurement is open to conditional escrows in principle, but we need:
- Formal SOW language that defines acceptance criteria for both windows
- Audit evidence that production logs will be retained for 90 days (we can accept equivalency statements but will need specifics)
- A short runbook for rollback/incident response for the first window

Legal will want to see the exact redline and a sample escrow instrument. Also: can you confirm the proposed dates for each window? Our execs want visibility on when the adapter delivery is expected (it drives training).

Cc'ing vendor_ops so they can surface any operational constraints.

Sara
Sara Kim
Senior Procurement Manager | Greenline Health
sara.kim@greenlinehealth.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP proposal: split release + procurement credit escrow request

Sara —

Thanks — quick answers inline and updated attachments attached: SOC2-equivalency-questions.docx (we've answered the 7 procurement items you flagged) and a revised MAP tab with dates. High level:
- Window A (API): target acceptance 2026-09-24 (QA pass -> customer sandbox -> 3-day acceptance)
- Window B (Adapter): target acceptance 2026-10-22 (integration testing -> parallel run -> final acceptance)

I've included acceptance criteria per window and a rollback runbook excerpt in SOW_v1_redline.pdf. For the escrow language, we've proposed an escrow release clause tied to the final acceptance sign-off.

If procurement wants a call, Ben and I can meet with you Wednesday 9/1 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Naomi
Attachments: SOW_v1_redline.pdf (pdf), SOC2-equivalency-questions.docx (docx), MAP_proposal_20260828.xlsx (updated)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenlinehealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP proposal: split release + procurement credit escrow request

Sara / Naomi —

Thanks for the update. From a commercial standpoint we can accommodate a $25k escrow and will reflect it as a conditional credit against the final invoice. A couple notes:
- We need procurement's sign-off on the acceptance checklist items in the SOW (Naomi's latest redline)
- If Greenline requires a formal escrow agent/3rd-party, that will add a small admin fee (we estimate ~$500-$750)

Marissa — looping you for visibility since this small credit and the timeline shift will need exec sign-off in our revenue ops. If we land on the two-window plan we should lock the MAP in HubSpot and tag the deal for a 10/22 close.

I can join the procurement call on Wednesday.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@acme.com, vendor_ops@greenlinehealth.com
Date: 2026-09-01T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP proposal: split release + procurement credit escrow request

Thanks all — procurement reviewed. Two items from our side before we can route to legal:
1) Replace the generic escrow clause with explicit release mechanics (who signs release, timeline for dispute, evidence required e.g., acceptance sign-off form)
2) Provide the KV cache / prefix-caching policy detail that Redwood will use (vendor_ops requested this to assess performance risk)

Legal will need the final redline SOW and the proposed escrow instrument by EOD Friday 9/3 to hit their internal sign cycles for a targeted 10/22 close. If Redwood can't provide the instrument, procurement will consider an alternative: a staged payment schedule with smaller interim payments and a final retention.

Sara

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: need quick exec ok on escrow instrument + rapid SOW turnaround

Marissa / Ben —

Escalating for a quick decision: Greenline requires an explicit escrow instrument or they will push to staged payments which increases our cash collection risk. Procurement is asking for the escrow mechanics and the final redline by EOD Friday 9/3 to keep the 10/22 target.

Impacts if we delay:
- Potential slip of Window B beyond 10/22 (est. +2–3 weeks)
- Possible request for increased retention vs. escrow (worse for our cashflow)

Proposed ask: approve the $25k escrow, authorize us to sign a simple escrow instruction (we'll route to legal to draft, Ben suggests we cover admin fee), and allow Naomi to commit the SOW redline with the acceptance checklist as-is. I can push the KV-cache policy doc to procurement by EOD as well.

If you want a 15-minute sync I can jump on a call now or tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Attachments referenced: MAP_proposal_20260828.xlsx, SOW_v1_redline.pdf, SOC2-equivalency-questions.docx
